name: Soulrot at 20 stacks deals its damage 15 sec after the first application (#9362)
contract: Soulrot 805196 makes Deathchaser 805190 damage apply debuff 804660, StackAmount 20, 15 sec (DurationIndex 8).
Its tooltip: 'At the end of the duration the enemy will take damage based on the number of stacks accrued.'
The damage is effect 1, PERIODIC_DAMAGE with amplitude 14999 ms. The report says that at 20 stacks the debuff
dissipates without dealing damage. A recorded Ascension combat log (2026-07-12, before this fork had Soulrot)
shows every Soulrot damage event 15.0-15.2 sec after the first application, even with stacks added 14.4 sec
after it, and the debuff removed with that damage: added stacks do not extend the debuff. Here Deathchaser is
recast for about 9 sec so the debuff reaches 20 stacks; expected: one damage event and the debuff gone about
15 sec after the first application, and no second damage afterwards.
Deathchaser is DmgClass 2 (melee), so the Reaper gets melee hit and expertise rating; Soulrot is covered by spell hit.
